Two promises the pre-launch checks caught canary breaking.

## The uninstall now leaves nothing

`install.sh` writes each block as a blank line, a marker comment, and the line
itself. `uninstall.sh` took the two lines back and left the blank. Install and
uninstall four times and the rc grew four blank lines: an uninstall that claims
to take back what it added, leaving a fingerprint anyway.

The blank that belongs to a marker now goes with it, and only that one. A run
of blanks before a marker keeps all but the last, because the others were your
own spacing. The installer test suite now compares the rc byte for byte across
three full rounds.

## `canary demo` pipes cleanly

`canary demo | tee log` wrote the screen-clears and cursor-ups into the file.
With no terminal on the other end the demo now prints one block per thing that
actually changed: no escape codes, no sleeping, the same words.

The stat row is left out of that comparison, so the bird is not reprinted
seventy times to show a minute counter moving.

Nothing else changed. Same bird, same numbers, same corpus.
